rules.description: Must have an active Marriage Allowance claim to cancel
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not have an active Marriage Allowance claim. No cancellation is needed.

rules.description: Must have a valid reason for cancellation
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a valid reason to cancel Marriage Allowance

rules.description: Either partner can cancel if relationship ended; otherwise must be original claimant
rules.reason_if_failed: Only the person who made the original claim can cancel, unless your relationship has ended

rules.description: Self Assessment filers must cancel via their tax return or by phone
rules.reason_if_failed: You are registered for Self Assessment. Please cancel via your tax return or call HMRC.

rules.description: If partner has died, must contact HMRC by phone
rules.reason_if_failed: If your partner has died, please contact HMRC Marriage Allowance enquiries on 0300 200 3300

edge_cases.description: Partner has died since Marriage Allowance claim began
edge_cases.action: Route to phone service. HMRC Marriage Allowance enquiries: 0300 200 3300. Different Personal Allowance rules apply.

edge_cases.description: User files Self Assessment tax return
edge_cases.action: Must cancel via Self Assessment return (leave Marriage Allowance section blank is NOT sufficient) or phone HMRC. Cannot cancel online.

edge_cases.description: Cancellation may cause tax underpayment for current year
edge_cases.action: Warn user: Backdating to 6 April may create underpayment. Consider calling HMRC to discuss payment arrangements.

edge_cases.description: User unsure if they are the original claimant
edge_cases.action: Route to phone service. HMRC can confirm who made the original claim from their records.
